hints.title: Observe Digit Sum Alternation
hints.text: In any sequence of 10 consecutive integers sharing the same prefix, exactly half have even digit sums.

hints.title: Test the Boundary
hints.text: Compute the sum of digits of num.

hints.title: Direct Division Formula
hints.text: If the digit sum of num is even, the answer is num // 2; otherwise it is (num - 1) // 2.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every number from 1 to num is unnecessary when parity alternates strictly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct evaluation runs in constant arithmetic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: State alternating parity property and formula.

solutions.approach: C++ digit extraction and arithmetic branch.
